name: Furnace plates
text: Scrap plating. The save improves by one against attacks from the front arc; a Prone fighter has no front arc.

name: Heavy carapace
text: Thick carapace plates, better still from the front. The wearer is slower to react and charges one inch less.

name: Bio-booster
text: The first time in a battle the wearer must roll Injury dice, one fewer is rolled (two are rolled and one discarded if it would have been a single die).

name: Stimm-slug stash
text: Used once per battle at the start of the wearer's activation. For the rest of the round the wearer gets +2 M, +2 S and +2 T and sheds one Flesh Wound. A roll of 1 on a D6 in the End phase forces an Injury roll.
